summary.headline: Update rings policy reference removes interim heading
summary.summary: The patch removes blank lines and an Update rings settings heading from the policy reference during the settings-content reorganization.
summary.adminImpact: Use the current section structure when locating ring settings.

summary.headline: Update rings article removes legacy Windows as a Service description
summary.summary: The article deletes a commented legacy introduction describing feature and quality servicing updates.

summary.headline: Settings Catalog OS edition filtering guidance expanded
summary.summary: The article date is updated and its Windows OS Edition filter guidance is revised as part of the January release.
summary.adminImpact: Review OS Edition filtering when scoping Windows Settings Catalog policies.

summary.headline: Update rings settings reference reorganized by policy rows
summary.summary: The article is retitled Update rings policy settings and moves Windows 10-to-latest Windows 11 upgrade information into the reorganized settings layout.
summary.adminImpact: Check the current policy row for Windows 11 upgrade eligibility guidance.

summary.headline: Update rings article removes unsupported setting list entries
summary.summary: The update rings article removes the listed feature deferral, uninstall period, and prerelease-build entries from its limitations text.
summary.adminImpact: Consult the policy settings reference for currently exposed controls.

summary.headline: Update rings device-requirements include path corrected
summary.summary: The shared device-configuration include path is corrected from three parent levels to two.

summary.headline: Android OEMConfig app list adds FCNT and Sonim
summary.summary: The supported OEMConfig app table adds FCNT Senior Care, FCNT Schema, and Sonim package identifiers.
summary.adminImpact: Use the listed package identifiers when configuring OEMConfig for those Android Enterprise device vendors.

summary.headline: Update rings subheadings reduced in level
summary.summary: Microsoft product updates and Windows drivers headings are changed from level-three to level-four headings.

summary.headline: Sign-In Assistant requirement formatting simplified
summary.summary: The Microsoft Account Sign-In Assistant service requirement is changed from a list item to a direct note.
summary.adminImpact: Keep wlidsvc enabled and running for update delivery.

summary.headline: Update ring product update setting converted from heading to bold label
summary.summary: Microsoft product updates is converted from a heading and list to a bold setting label with Allow and Block choices.
summary.adminImpact: Set Allow to scan Microsoft Update for app updates, or Block to prevent the scan.
